rows.label: Neonatal mortality, Sub-Saharan Africa (deaths in the first 28 days per live birth, 2023)

source.title: UN IGME, Levels and Trends in Child Mortality, Report 2024
source.quote: Sub-Saharan Africa neonatal mortality rate 27 deaths per 1,000 live births

rows.explainer: Deaths in the first 28 days per live birth in Sub-Saharan Africa, the rate a newborn package acts on where a charity's maternal and newborn work is spread over the region; the range is the estimate's uncertainty and the spread across countries (24-30 per 1,000).

rows.label: Deaths from one month to five years per live birth, Sub-Saharan Africa (2023)

source.title: UN IGME, Levels and Trends in Child Mortality, Report 2024
source.quote: Sub-Saharan Africa under-five mortality rate 70 deaths per 1,000 live births; neonatal 27

rows.explainer: Under-five mortality less neonatal mortality: 70 − 27 = 43 per 1,000 live births; the range is the estimate's uncertainty and the spread across countries.

rows.label: Stillbirths per birth, Sub-Saharan Africa (2021)

source.title: UN IGME, Never Forgotten: stillbirth estimates report 2023
source.quote: Sub-Saharan Africa stillbirth rate about 21 per 1,000 total births

rows.explainer: Stillbirths (at 28 weeks or later) per total births in Sub-Saharan Africa; the range is the estimate's uncertainty and the spread across countries.

rows.label: Diarrhoeal deaths per person-year, Sub-Saharan Africa (all ages, 2021)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2021 results tool (diarrhoeal diseases, Sub-Saharan Africa, all ages, deaths per 100,000)

rows.explainer: The all-age diarrhoeal death rate a new water supply acts on where a charity's water work is spread over the region; wide because the GBD estimate varies by country and year (the 2023 round puts the region's deaths at 419,280, about 33 per 100,000: @death_ages.diarrhoea_ssa_share_under5's note).
